description: Starts the project's plan over from scratch in the background, the same as pressing Start plan fresh on Plan: refreshes live site pages from the sitemap, runs a fresh audit first when the project allows one, then rebuilds the 90-day strategy, this week and the whole month from a clean slate. Unapproved pieces from the old plan are cleared; anything already approved or published stays. Run only when the owner explicitly asked to start the plan fresh. Returns right away while planning runs; check get_overview or work_list in a few minutes for progress and the new revision. It spends the owner's tokens as the chat's same tool would: say the price before you spend.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

reason.description: Optional short note on why the plan is being rebuilt from scratch.

name: plan_fresh
title: Start plan fresh
